g.text: System prompts are 'soft' constraints -- they change the model's
input context rather than its weights. Yet they can significantly
steer token distributions, especially for persona and formatting.
Compare this to RLHF (Adventure 02), which permanently reshapes
KL penalty = hard constraint in PPO
Different beta values shift the KL
KL penalty resists large policy changes
Reward model scores vary by context
Global mean KL = average steering cost
